title: Lindy AI Pricing 2026: Plans, Credits & Cost Per Task
summary: Lindy AI pricing starts at $29.99 per seat monthly, but credits used and plan limits determine total spend. Calculate how much you'll actually pay.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


Once you have measured your own credit burn, a few billing questions are still worth settling before you pay. Lindy's terms can change, so check each answer on its pricing page and in your account settings on the day you buy.


Is there a free Lindy AI plan? Treat any free access as a measuring tool, not a place to run production work. Check the pricing page for what is offered today.


Whatever allowance you get, run your real task through it and record the credits it consumes, because that number is what you scale to a paid plan.


Do unused Lindy credits roll over? Don't assume they do. Subscription credit allowances commonly reset each billing cycle, so buying a larger plan "to have headroom" may mean paying for credits that vanish.


Look at your balance at the end of your first cycle and see what happened. If the balance reset, size your plan to a typical month, not a peak one.


### Can I cancel Lindy or switch plans mid-month?


Cancellation is normally handled in your account's billing settings, and you should do it before the renewal date, not after.


A plan change may take effect immediately or at the next renewal, and refunds for the unused part of a cycle aren't something to count on. Read the confirmation screen before you click, and switch early in a cycle if you can.


### Does Lindy offer discounts for annual billing or startups?


Annual billing is the usual place for a discount, so look for a billing toggle on the pricing page and compare the two totals.


Run that comparison only after you have measured a few months of real usage. A prepaid year at the wrong plan size costs more than a monthly plan you can adjust.


For startup or volume terms, ask support in writing and get the terms stated back to you, rather than agreeing to them on a call.


### What happens when Lindy credits run out?


Your automations either stop running until the next cycle, or you buy more credits or move up a plan.


Which one applies to you is the thing to confirm, because an agent that halts mid-task can leave a customer reply or a data update half finished.


Before you rely on Lindy for anything time-sensitive, **deliberately run a small account to zero** and watch what happens to the workflow.
